# gemini-advisor

> Python advisor tool for Gemini and Google Antigravity agents. A fast executor
> model calls `advisor(question, context)` to get guidance from a stronger Gemini
> model. Works as a tool in the Google Antigravity SDK and in google-genai
> automatic function calling. Modeled on Claude's advisor tool.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/NiksheyYadav/gemini-advisor/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, options, and differences from Claude's advisor
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/NiksheyYadav/gemini-advisor/blob/main/skills/gemini-advisor/SKILL.md): how an agent should set up and use the tool
- [Source](https://github.com/NiksheyYadav/gemini-advisor/blob/main/gemini_advisor/advisor.py): `make_advisor_tool()`
- [Tests](https://github.com/NiksheyYadav/gemini-advisor/blob/main/tests/test_advisor.py): unit tests with a fake client

## Facts

- Language: Python. Dependency: google-genai (only for real calls).
- Default advisor model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (a preview name).
- Default cap: 5 advisor calls per tool instance.
- Status: unit-tested, not yet verified against the live Gemini API.
- License: MIT.
